description: Use this when the connected user asks to stop or restart AIApply applying for them. action="pause" stops all automatic applying and is destructive: call it without confirmed, show the user what will stop, ask them, then call again with confirmed=true. action="resume" restarts applying and spends credits, so confirm it the same way. To stop applications to particular roles only, this is the wrong tool — that is a preference change the user makes in AIApply. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one. It also needs a permission the user grants; if it was not granted, calling it asks the user to allow it.

action.description: pause stops all automatic applying; resume restarts it.

confirmed.description: True only after the user has explicitly agreed to this change.

name: pause_resume_applications

applied.description: True only when the queue changed.

error.description: True when the change could not be made.

queue_status.description: The status the queue now holds.

reason.description: Why nothing changed, when nothing did.

user_message.description: Show this to the user rather than message.

title: Pause or resume AIApply applications
